description: This file is a shell script that sets up and manages IPv4-in-IPv6 tunnel configurations for OpenWrt’s network stack. It defines functions for initializing options, setting up the tunnel (proto_map_setup), tearing it down (proto_map_teardown), and configuring protocol specifics. The script interacts with system files, network interfaces, and JSON configuration data to establish the correct tunnel parameters, handle errors, and communicate with other components such as ubus and the firewall.

methods.name: proto_map_setup
methods.description: Sets up IPv4-in-IPv6 tunnel based on configuration variables, generating rules, initializing tunnel interfaces, and configuring firewall rules accordingly.

methods.name: proto_map_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the configured tunnel, removing interface configurations and related system entries.

methods.name: proto_map_init_config
methods.description: Defines the configuration parameters required for setting up the map protocol, including mapping types and address prefixes.
